title: Design system
intro: Marea Baja’s tokens, type and base components, with every state visible for accessibility audits.

brand.title: Brand
brand.intro: A single-stroke mark: the wave closes into a bowl. The 引潮 seal is secondary and only appears on the catch of the day, the order confirmation and packaging.
brand.logoLight: Horizontal and stacked logo on Espuma
brand.logoDark: Logo on Tinta and the mark at its minimum size (24 px)
brand.hanko: 引潮 seal at 48 and 72 px (SVG graphic, pending native review)
brand.tide: Tide line: the only recurring graphic motif

colors.title: Color
colors.intro: Approved palette and derived tokens. Components use semantic tokens that point to these colors.
colors.contrastTitle: Contrast of the system’s color pairs

use.never: Never as text (only the color pair is shown)

type.title: Typography
type.intro: Shippori Mincho B1 for names, from 22 px up; Zen Kaku Gothic New for reading. Sizes step up from 1024 px.

samples.bodyLg: We cut the fish when you order. If it didn’t come in today, it isn’t on the menu.
samples.body: Ají amarillo tiger’s milk, miso-glazed sweet potato, toasted corn and chive oil.
samples.meta: Came in at 06:40 · Gulf of Nicoya

glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.intro: Check V3: accents, ñ, ü, Spanish opening marks, quotes, dashes and digits render in the approved typefaces. They have no ₡ glyph; a fallback font limited to that one character provides it.

buttons.title: Buttons and states
buttons.intro: One primary action per view. 2 px radius, 48 px minimum height and no shadows. The disabled state explains why.
buttons.catchOfTheDay: See the catch of the day

forms.title: Fields and forms
forms.intro: The label always sits above, help text below, and errors carry an icon and text. On a failed submit, focus moves to the summary.
forms.name: First name

errors.reference: Directions: tell us how to get there

options.title: Options and quantity
options.intro: Dish options with the price difference on the right. The extras counter is announced to screen readers.
options.quantityNote: The stepper edits the total quantity, with no cap at 20 (rule C5). The API splits it into internal lines of up to 20.

menu.title: Menu line
menu.intro: Name, dot leaders and price aligned like a printed menu. Tags always carry text; the photo lives on the dish sheet. Includes the longest expected name and price.

dishes.clasico: Mesino lime tiger’s milk, ají limo, glazed sweet potato and toasted corn.
dishes.nikkei: Tuna, soy and yuzu tiger’s milk, cucumber, black sesame and nori.
dishes.tiradito: Thin slices of octopus, ají amarillo tiger’s milk, toasted sesame oil and chives.
dishes.olivo: Not enough octopus came in today. Back tomorrow.

motion.title: Motion
motion.intro: 150 ms for hover, 250 ms for panels and 400 ms, once, for the logo stroke. With reduced motion nothing animates.
